documents.population: 外国学校卒業学生特別選考 第1種(私費留学生): privately financed international applicants from foreign schools, April 2027 entry (Natural Sciences I/II stream for the Faculty of Science / Information Science)
documents.notes: 2027年度 東京大学外国学校卒業学生特別選考募集要項, Type 1 (privately financed international students): application 1-7 December 2026, essay and interview February-March 2027, all in Japanese. The guide states the 2027 academic year (2027年度); UTokyo has no autumn intake on this route. Not drafted: optional national/unified examination results (SAT, AP, ACT, Gaokao, CSAT; 【任意】), the mailing label. The EJU (日本留学試験) examination voucher is drafted as entrance_test; TOEFL/IELTS scores are sent directly by the testing body.
